requirements.title: Milestone boundary and invariant
requirements.summary: Patient app, treatment timeline and medication reminders. Synthetic-only implementation; retain doctor ownership, independent secretary grants and separate patient identity/relationship/encounter; no clinical/legal/provider/commercial authority inferred.
requirements.provenance: Supplied roadmap v0.2 plus current delegated scope.

requirements.title: Patient identity claim and consent design
requirements.summary: Approve safe linking of a patient to doctor records; matching phone/email alone is insufficient. Acceptance: Define evidence-backed patient claim flow binding an authenticated patient identity to a specific doctor-practice relationship, with verification expiry, audit and dispute handling. Separate patient login identity, each doctor relationship, encounter and caregiver authority; contact equality alone never links or merges records. Approve consent, revocation and recovery rules with the accountable reviewer; no global chart sharing or reciprocal doctor access follows a successful claim. Prepare evidence for DOS-M5-GATE-IDENTITY. Stop before any provider/native/live-data dependent implementation until the accountable reviewer approves the relevant decision; producing this packet does not grant approval.
requirements.provenance: Detailed decomposition of DOS-M5-001 from supplied roadmap; ordinary design choices, evidence-gated domain decisions.

requirements.title: Patient app shell and secure onboarding
requirements.summary: Implement the chosen patient platforms with verified identity, recovery and consent history. Acceptance: Choose and approve patient platforms/distribution explicitly, reusing M4 architectural evidence only where applicable; register exact platform source/test commands before scaffold. Implement secure patient onboarding, claim challenge, recovery and consent-history views with minimal collected fields and product-isolated sessions. Unclaimed or disputed relationships remain unavailable and enrollment never implies medication or communication consent. Use only the explicitly approved platform/renderer and registered build/device test commands. The reserved mobile path grants no framework choice; re-review the packet and registration after the platform decision, before native implementation. Prepare evidence for DOS-M5-GATE-PLATFORM. Stop before any provider/native/live-data dependent implementation until the accountable reviewer approves the relevant decision; producing this packet does not grant approval.
requirements.provenance: Detailed decomposition of DOS-M5-002 from supplied roadmap; ordinary design choices, evidence-gated domain decisions.

requirements.title: Caregivers, dependents and revocation
requirements.summary: Implement approved minor/guardian/caregiver relationships with explicit scope and expiry/revocation. Acceptance: Represent caregiver/dependent authorization as named grantor, recipient, patient, scope, validity and revocation with evidence of authority. Apply approved age/guardian rules without guessing legal thresholds; each caregiver uses an independent account and limited permissions. Revoke future reads/actions and cached access under the approved policy while retaining consent and action provenance. Use only the explicitly approved platform/renderer and registered build/device test commands. The reserved mobile path grants no framework choice; re-review the packet and registration after the platform decision, before native implementation.
requirements.provenance: Detailed decomposition of DOS-M5-003 from supplied roadmap; ordinary design choices, evidence-gated domain decisions.

requirements.title: Doctor and clinic care timeline
requirements.summary: Show released visits/prescriptions by doctor/location without granting doctors reciprocal chart access. Acceptance: Project only released visits/prescriptions into a patient timeline grouped by explicit doctor/location and source version. Do not expose private working notes, unreviewed results or another person sharing contact details; doctors gain no reciprocal chart access. Handle pagination, revoked release, empty relationships and corrected provenance without silently combining clinical records. Use only the explicitly approved platform/renderer and registered build/device test commands. The reserved mobile path grants no framework choice; re-review the packet and registration after the platform decision, before native implementation.
requirements.provenance: Detailed decomposition of DOS-M5-004 from supplied roadmap; ordinary design choices, evidence-gated domain decisions.

requirements.title: Prescription detail and current-version handling
requirements.summary: Show clear start/end dates, doctor instructions, active/amended/stopped state and provenance. Acceptance: Show exact signed instructions, medicine identity, dates, prescriber and current version/status without substituting medical interpretation. Clearly distinguish active, future, completed, stopped, superseded and as-needed instructions; uncertain state does not render as current advice. Refresh/reconcile amended versions before reminder creation and retain source-version links for historical actions. Use only the explicitly approved platform/renderer and registered build/device test commands. The reserved mobile path grants no framework choice; re-review the packet and registration after the platform decision, before native implementation.
requirements.provenance: Detailed decomposition of DOS-M5-005 from supplied roadmap; ordinary design choices, evidence-gated domain decisions.

requirements.title: Dose-event schedule engine
requirements.summary: Derive deterministic scheduled reminders from signed instructions with timezone and change handling. Acceptance: Translate only approved signed structured schedules into deterministic reminder events identified by prescription version, segment and occurrence. Specify timezone/clock-change, start/end inclusivity, daylight-saving gaps/folds and explicit anchors with clinician-reviewed test vectors; ambiguous/as-needed instructions require approved handling rather than inferred dosing. Version the scheduling algorithm and cancel obsolete events on amendment/stop; never calculate medical doses or advise missed-dose compensation. Use only the explicitly approved platform/renderer and registered build/device test commands. The reserved mobile path grants no framework choice; re-review the packet and registration after the platform decision, before native implementation. Prepare evidence for DOS-M5-GATE-REMINDERS. Stop before any provider/native/live-data dependent implementation until the accountable reviewer approves the relevant decision; producing this packet does not grant approval.
requirements.provenance: Detailed decomposition of DOS-M5-006 from supplied roadmap; ordinary design choices, evidence-gated domain decisions.

requirements.title: Device notification permission and channel handling
requirements.summary: Handle OS permission, disabled notifications, app reinstall and delivery limitations honestly. Acceptance: Request OS notification permission at an explained point and record per-device/channel capability without treating permission as guaranteed delivery. Handle denied/revoked permissions, app reinstall, OS restrictions and disabled channels with truthful status and recovery steps. Use minimal notification content appropriate to approved privacy settings; account/caregiver revocation disables future private alerts. Use only the explicitly approved platform/renderer and registered build/device test commands. The reserved mobile path grants no framework choice; re-review the packet and registration after the platform decision, before native implementation.
requirements.provenance: Detailed decomposition of DOS-M5-007 from supplied roadmap; ordinary design choices, evidence-gated domain decisions.

requirements.title: Taken, skip and snooze interactions
requirements.summary: Snooze affects notification time only; action retries are idempotent and never rewrite the prescribed regimen. Acceptance: Record taken/skip/snooze as patient-reported actions linked to an immutable dose-event ID with idempotent commands. Snooze changes notification time only and never rewrites prescription, event dose or regimen; show original schedule alongside snooze state. Permit explicit correction with provenance and conflicts handled consistently across devices; no action produces medical advice. Use only the explicitly approved platform/renderer and registered build/device test commands. The reserved mobile path grants no framework choice; re-review the packet and registration after the platform decision, before native implementation.
requirements.provenance: Detailed decomposition of DOS-M5-008 from supplied roadmap; ordinary design choices, evidence-gated domain decisions.

requirements.title: Missed reminders and stop/amend reconciliation
requirements.summary: Cancel obsolete reminders and avoid duplicate alerts or invented double-dose advice. Acceptance: Reconcile missing/late notifications separately from patient adherence and scheduled dose occurrence; a delivery failure is not proof of a missed dose. Stop/amend revokes obsolete pending reminders, retains historical action provenance and never schedules compensating double doses. Use deterministic expiry/reconciliation states so delayed delivery and reconnect do not resurrect stopped events. Use only the explicitly approved platform/renderer and registered build/device test commands. The reserved mobile path grants no framework choice; re-review the packet and registration after the platform decision, before native implementation.
requirements.provenance: Detailed decomposition of DOS-M5-009 from supplied roadmap; ordinary design choices, evidence-gated domain decisions.

requirements.title: Adherence history and patient corrections
requirements.summary: Record patient-reported actions distinctly from verified administration and permit auditable correction. Acceptance: Store patient/caregiver-reported adherence separately from verified administration, with actor, event/version and device/server timestamps. Allow audited correction without deleting prior events and show uncertainty/conflicting reports explicitly. Doctor visibility requires approved release/consent scope; adherence is not a diagnostic conclusion or automatic treatment change. Use only the explicitly approved platform/renderer and registered build/device test commands. The reserved mobile path grants no framework choice; re-review the packet and registration after the platform decision, before native implementation.
requirements.provenance: Detailed decomposition of DOS-M5-010 from supplied roadmap; ordinary design choices, evidence-gated domain decisions.

requirements.title: Multi-device sync and notification deduplication
requirements.summary: Reconcile action conflicts, clock/timezone changes and multiple devices without repeated dose events. Acceptance: Assign stable event/action IDs and reconcile multiple devices with idempotency, explicit conflict policy and authoritative server versions. Deduplicate notification scheduling/delivery according to approved device ownership/channel policy; offline conflicts remain visible until reconciled. Handle device revocation, clock skew, timezone changes and prescription amendments without duplicate dose events or lost corrections. Use only the explicitly approved platform/renderer and registered build/device test commands. The reserved mobile path grants no framework choice; re-review the packet and registration after the platform decision, before native implementation.
requirements.provenance: Detailed decomposition of DOS-M5-011 from supplied roadmap; ordinary design choices, evidence-gated domain decisions.

requirements.title: Appointments and released results
requirements.summary: Show authorized appointments/results and follow-up instructions with doctor provenance. Acceptance: Show only authorized appointments, clinician-released results and follow-up instructions with doctor/location provenance. Keep operational appointment state separate from result interpretation; a received result is hidden until release. Apply patient/caregiver scope, revocation and current-version checks on direct links and cached views. Use only the explicitly approved platform/renderer and registered build/device test commands. The reserved mobile path grants no framework choice; re-review the packet and registration after the platform decision, before native implementation.
requirements.provenance: Detailed decomposition of DOS-M5-012 from supplied roadmap; ordinary design choices, evidence-gated domain decisions.

requirements.title: Accessible patient experience and limited-connectivity behavior
requirements.summary: Support readable instructions, accessible actions and safe minimal caching for approved users/devices. Acceptance: Verify readable bilingual instructions, text scaling, screen reader order, contrast, keyboard/switch access where supported and reachable primary actions. Show last-sync/offline/unsupported notification states truthfully; cache only the approved minimum for approved devices/users. Protect sensitive previews and clear expired/revoked cache; accessibility adaptations cannot hide or alter prescription meaning. Use only the explicitly approved platform/renderer and registered build/device test commands. The reserved mobile path grants no framework choice; re-review the packet and registration after the platform decision, before native implementation.
requirements.provenance: Detailed decomposition of DOS-M5-013 from supplied roadmap; ordinary design choices, evidence-gated domain decisions.

requirements.title: Reminder safety and patient pilot acceptance
requirements.summary: Test real-device timing/permissions/snooze/amendment scenarios with clinical review; never promise guaranteed alarms. Acceptance: Validate deterministic schedule vectors and real-device permission, background, snooze, travel, stop/amend and multi-device scenarios against the exact candidate. Obtain independent clinical and patient-usability review; simulated data acceptance does not authorize real patients. Any supervised patient pilot requires separate M7 real-data authorization and consent; document alarm limitations and never promise guaranteed reminders. Use only the explicitly approved platform/renderer and registered build/device test commands. The reserved mobile path grants no framework choice; re-review the packet and registration after the platform decision, before native implementation.

Acquire parent-reviewed transaction serialization lock and reread every scoped ID; existing equal payload is a no-op only after full canonical comparison; any differing state/history aborts. Never overwrite existing tasks, decisions, execution or requirement history.
Create or verify the real OPEN milestone start decision before any task; create every task through supported function and link every task to that decision with blocking=true in the SAME transaction.
Create all requirement, decision and dependency links and refresh contracts after final metadata. Do not commit partial task/link batches.

Assert exact payload counts, complete links, zero ready Doctor tasks using live ready-task predicate, zero claims/runs/executions, no publication authority, and all start decisions still OPEN immediately before commit.
Dry-run rollback and review returned evidence first. Parent controls any commit; never remove a guard from the original draft SQL.
